subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four stale assertions are repaired, should the token-, scanning-, registry-, and Codex-action updates land together on the final rebased head?
rationale: The repair itself is mechanical, but the protected security label leaves acceptance of this grouped privileged dependency set to a maintainer.

options.title: Repair and land together
options.body: Update the assertions, verify the final immutable revisions, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate the sensitive action families into smaller pull requests for isolated validation.

options.title: Pause the group
options.body: Wait for Dependabot to maintain a stable rebased head before continuing review.

recommendation.title: Repair and land together
recommendation.body: Update the assertions, verify the final immutable revisions, and merge only after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to the exact workflow guard contracts that define the repair and validation boundary.
